The plate is about 26 cm across in the photo (roughly 565 px wide), so I scaled each item against that.

**Bread roll:** it is about 225 px long, which is roughly 10 cm at that scale, and about 3.5 cm wide and 3 cm tall. That is a small baguette-style roll of about 60 g, at 270 kcal/100 g.

**Roasted chicken:** the piece is a breast with skin, plus some loose skin and shredded meat. It covers roughly 1/4 of the plate and is about 4–5 cm tall, so I estimate about 180 g including the skin, and used 190 kcal/100 g for skin-on roast chicken. I split it into two items. The meat is about 130 g at 165 kcal/100 g. The skin is about 40 g at a high 450 kcal/100 g.
